title: Confidential pre-emergency reserve-pool feasibility

selected_opportunity.origin: Researcher-agent cross-round synthesis after reviewing all 12 independent search proposals and primary prior art. It was not supplied in the initial brief and was not one of the blinded U/E outputs.
selected_opportunity.discovered_connection: Underserved small-utility reserve coordination plus confidential coupled computation and explicit semantic/output authorization yields a joint planning answer without an aggregate raw-inventory database.
selected_opportunity.useful_output: One aggregate feasibility bit for the complete preauthorized family of simultaneous claims over supplied eligibility, availability and withheld-owner-reserve constraints.
selected_opportunity.specific_gap: SPAREConnect documents contact discovery, emergency/nonroutine requests and voluntary bilateral terms, not this pre-emergency coupled answer; GridAssurance supplies dedicated inventory rather than this owner-held-input computation. These distinctions do not prove competitor incapacity or customer demand.
prior_art_boundary: Private coupled resource feasibility is established prior art: SIAM DOI 10.1137/19M127879X.
Prime Match demonstrates production private financial-inventory matching with stronger malicious security.
MPC, Shamir secret sharing and Hall’s theorem are established components, not new inventions.
selected_opportunity.evidence_of_need: GAO-23-106180 documents limited participation, cost and administrative barriers for smaller utilities. A privacy-sensitive segment and willingness to pay remain explicit hypotheses, not GAO findings.
selected_opportunity.independent_review: Conditional go for bounded application construction; no world-first, universal foresight or proven-market claim.

transformation_witness.original_purpose: Learn whether cooperation can satisfy every declared simultaneous-reserve requirement before paying for broader disclosure, engineering and contracting.
transformation_witness.restriction: No coordinator may collect all raw private eligibility, availability and retention inputs. Individually eligible matches do not establish simultaneous coverage.
transformation_witness.change: Evaluate joint feasibility through established secret sharing, with a fixed public shape and one authorized output per independent input epoch.
preserved_obligations: Every declared demand and scenario remains; each asset can serve at most one demand within an incident.
Withheld owner assets remain unavailable; the instrument does not invent compatibility or transport access.
No raw inventory is released by the declared computation; participants explicitly authorize its output and metadata.
A negative answer means the supplied evidence does not certify feasibility, not physical impossibility.
acceptance: Actual three-process MPC agrees with an independent cleartext oracle.
A known simultaneous-claim counterexample returns false.
Changing scenario or epoch invalidates the earlier local authorization.
The algorithm has no secret-dependent public branches; released output contains no raw inputs.
falsifiers: Disclosure beyond the authorized function output and declared metadata under the supported threat model.
Omission of a scenario or relaxation of an owner constraint.
A competent incumbent economically supplies the required result to the target segment.
Buyer values, consent or complete costs eliminate viable participation.

selected_opportunity.rights: Synthetic inputs and new Apache-2.0 code; MPyC is MIT licensed. Public sources are attributed. No real confidential inventory or customer data is used.
selected_opportunity.next_construction: Actual local three-party execution, strong controls, frozen fresh origin/successor cases, complete modeled economics and existing Nova/FusionPlan/MARK artifact integration.

technical_construction.interpretation: The supplied public technical summary is retained exactly in meaning; numeric decimals are explicit strings for the native Nova parser. Its own result labels and limitations govern every claim.

protocol.technical_scope: Three utility/computation parties, two padded asset slots each and six public demand locations; binary private declared eligibility and per-scenario availability/retention.
protocol.function: For every listed nonempty demand subset up to max_claims, an injective eligible available nonwithheld asset assignment exists. Output conjunction only.
protocol.security_model: MPyC 0.11 Shamir protocols, passive adversaries controlling at most one of three parties. Local processes are research roles, not independent organizations. No malicious-security, truthful-input, remote-deployment or physical-dispatch claim.
protocol.leakage: One authorized aggregate bit per independent world, plus fixed public dimensions, scenario family, role/source identities and timing/communication metadata. A bit can reveal private information with side information. Fixed scope/epoch and one-use authorization limit adaptive queries.

algorithms.instrument: Secret-shared Hall conditions over every nonempty demand subset of each scenario.
algorithms.independent_oracle: Cleartext backtracking enumeration of injective allocations; does not call the Hall implementation.
algorithms.weak_diagnostic: Each individual request has an eligible usable asset, ignoring contention. This is a diagnostic, not ordinary frontier-model U.
algorithms.competent_same_information: Identical standard MPC artifact invoked from an ordinary library, with the same information; exact parity is the null.
algorithms.human: Estimated development pathway, not an observed human trial.

protocol.data: Entirely synthetic declared inventories. No fixture establishes hardware compatibility. Seeds define test cases, not calibrated failure probabilities.
protocol.measurement_policy: Preserve all worlds and refusals. Measure exact oracle agreement, diagnostic false positives, elapsed time and bytes. Confidence intervals describe draws from the synthetic generator. Runtime comparisons are descriptive local measurements.
protocol.freeze_rule: Resolve construction failures using development/probe cases. Then commit worker, driver, protocol and dependencies before generating fresh confirmation inputs. Preserve and re-freeze any correction with new seeds.
protocol.actual_expenditure: Complete real research/API expenditure is unknown; hosted model billing is not exposed. Actual customer collections are zero.
protocol.research_batch_authority: A research manifest authorizes the complete fixed batch: one bit for each independent synthetic input world, hence 120 bits for a 120-world batch. The local authority binds the entire batch and prohibits replay. The prospective customer offering authorizes exactly one world per query epoch.
protocol.retention_semantics: Asset-specific withholding, not an arbitrary minimum-reserve quota. Each input row is one distinct unit-capacity asset and each demand needs one asset.

technical_result.commercial_result: Technical evidence only; no actual sale or economic gain inferred.
technical_result.confidence_boundary: Reference intervals describe synthetic test generation, not real utility reliability. Manual challenges have no sampling inference.
technical_result.evidence_label: Actual local multiparty execution on entirely public synthetic declared inputs

manual_challenges.pair_to_triple_counterexample: Two universal usable assets cover all singles/pairs but fail triple coverage.

technical_result.operational_alpha: No numerical E/U gain established. Identical ordinary library ties.
technical_result.retained_alpha: Portability on fresh work, not incremental E+ monetary gain or independent cryptographic competence.
technical_result.scope: One aggregate conjunction per independent world; 120 bits per explicitly authorized 120-world research batch. The customer offering is one world per epoch. Three local processes are not independent organizations.
technical_result.successor: Separate recipient context, fresh generated inputs and new local grant; unchanged instrument and no prior answers in recipient context.

query_arrangement.owner_inputs: Three simulated owners each retain two padded asset slots. Only their own worker reads their synthetic private owner file.
query_arrangement.public_function: For every authorized simultaneous-claim scenario, some eligible injective allocation exists after applying availability and owner withholding. The required allocation may differ across scenarios.
query_arrangement.origin: The complete 21-scenario singleton and pair family over six public demand locations.
query_arrangement.successor: The complete 41-scenario family including triples, with fresh input meaning and separate explicit authority.
query_arrangement.output_consent: One aggregate bit per independent world, with declared public dimensions, scenario family, identities and communication/timing metadata. A bit can reveal private information when combined with side information.
query_arrangement.batch_boundary: A research batch may explicitly authorize 120 independent synthetic worlds and 120 bits. The prospective bounded offering has one world and one bit per authorized epoch.
query_arrangement.authority: Current local signed controller grant, exact source/input commitment, expiry, nonce and atomic scope/epoch reservation. Simulated identities do not establish live ENS, independent organizations or real owner consent.

commercial_evidence.unknown_cost_treatment: Unknown research and hosted-model expenditure is not silently set to zero.
commercial_evidence.protocol_amount_boundary: The package's minimum token bounties and no-funding MARK arithmetic are encoding fixtures; they are not service prices, financing, earned revenue or profitable delivery.

supplied_protocol_terms.bounty: 100 base units per job is the existing FusionPlan schema minimum and is unfunded. No USD conversion is assumed.
supplied_protocol_terms.duration: Seven days is a research package encoding allowance, not a measured or sold service-level promise.
supplied_protocol_terms.price_weight: 5,000 basis points is an explicit unused protocol placeholder, not an optimized commercial policy.

opportunity.component_boundary: Hosted blind-search records and the cross-round construction establish discovery provenance. Insight schema handling, Nova encryption and FusionPlan commitments preserve records; they do not establish discovery quality, scientific acceptance or commercial value.
